newsitem.title: GERMANY: German debt firm amid central banker comments.
newsitem.headline: German debt firm amid central banker comments.

text.p: German Bunds and futures retained their firm undertone in late dealings on Tuesday after a volatile trading session where various central bankers battled for the markets' attention.
The December Bund futures traded on Frankfurt's DTB were up 10 basis points at 98.09 at 1500 GMT having reached a session high of 98.35 and a low of 97.92.

Watching gains come and go almost within the bat of an eye, traders said they could not predict where the market may head Wednesday. "We will just have to wait and see, keeping an eye on upcoming August M3 data and the Ifo data," a dealer said.
